evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server core handling in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
rationale: Fixes backpressure defeat and socket event handling in the HTTP server that caused intermittent test failures. As noted in issue #36216 and by the author, 'the worst-case scenario for this bug is only 65kB so this is not a critical OOM fix', but it corrects improper socket reading while requests are in flight.
